result: No credential findings detected within the documented scope; no absolute absence guarantee.
upload_privacy_gate: Not verified by this scan. Parent must verify repository Private before any upload.

scanner.name: Gitleaks
scanner.config: Explicit useDefault=true, built-in rule set/allowlists, no project config/ignore files, ignore-gitleaks-allow=true, max-decode-depth=3, redact=100

rules: literal credential/password assignments, including low-entropy strings

media_ocr.sampling: 3 frames (first/middle/near end) from52 videos; first frame from1 durationless video;5 audio-only files have no frames

false_positive_or_public_metadata_review.classification: Public upstream @author attribution; not an authentication secret. Values intentionally omitted.
false_positive_or_public_metadata_review.git_identity_handling: Conventional Git authorship identities retained; values omitted from the report. No history edits.

limitations: Only local reachable refs and the upload branch ancestry were inspected. Remote branches not fetched locally, unreachable Git objects/reflogs, and remote release attachments were not inspected.
Credential rules and supplemental patterns do not prove absence of every possible secret or personal detail.
OCR used English (eng); Arabic personal text was not comprehensively recognized. OCR may miss small, obscured, wrapped, or imperfect text.
Video sampling: first/middle/near-end frames of52 visual videos and first frame of1 durationless visual video. Other frames were not inspected.
Five audio-only WEBM files were not transcribed; spoken sensitive information was not assessed.
Ten WOFF2 font binaries and binary semantic/steganographic content were not comprehensively inspected.
No actual external credential stores or environment values were read. The scan made no repository source, Git history, branch, or ZIP changes.
artifacts_policy: Sanitized report only outside checkout. Raw temporary scan outputs remain restricted under /tmp/vlex-security-review; no credential values are emitted.
